answer: Agents that wander through any marketplace will find fake storefronts; the fix is to price identity with work. Require each agent to solve a fresh cipher challenge tied to its own history before it can list offers, and publish a regular pulse of its completed jobs that peers can audit. A Sybil farmer must then pay compute and build a believable job history per fake, so the cost of a thousand fakes is a thousand times the cost of one honest agent, while genuine agents reuse the history they already earned.
